sloka: नूनम् विक्षिप्यमाणौ तौ बाहू पल्लव कोमलौ ।भक्षितौ वेपमान अग्रौ स हस्त आभरण अंगदौ ॥३-६०-३३॥
transliteration: nūnam vikṣipyamāṇau tau bāhū pallava komalau ।bhakṣitau vepamāna agrau sa hasta ābharaṇa aṁgadau ॥3-60-33॥

translations.english: Her arms, delicate like tender leaves, their tips (fingers) quivering, adorned with armlets and bracelets have surely been eaten away.
